reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
Every time there’s a new drop, I add the items to my cart immediately. But as soon as I go to checkout, everything disappears from my cart and suddenly shows as “Sold Out.” I don’t even get a chance to pay.

It feels like the app is giving people false hope just to create hype. If an item is already unavailable, don’t let customers add it to their cart in the first place. This system is incredibly frustrating and unfair.

I’ve missed multiple releases because of this issue. Fix your checkout system instead of wasting your customers’ time.

reviews.title: Order
reviews.text:
Ordered during the Black Friday sale and the parcel was lost in transit. It took nearly a month of back-and-forth just to get a clear answer. By the time Gymshark admitted the order was lost, the main item I wanted was out of stock, so a replacement wasn’t even possible.

Customer service were polite, but the process was slow and dragged out far longer than it should have. Being offered store credit for items that were no longer available after such a long delay felt frustrating, especially given the premium prices.

Eventually had to opt for a refund, but the whole experience has put me off ordering again. For the price point, I expected far better logistics and resolution speed.

reviews.title: ALWAYS Out of sizes!
reviews.text: Gymshark clothes are great……if they ever have your size in stock. I know it’s the Holidays, but trying to pick out 2 matching sets was the equivalent of having my wisdom teeth chiseled from my head. Absolutely terrible experience! Never again! I really feel like this is my last order and I’ve been wearing the brand for years. It’s harder and harder to find sizes when there are more options out there where you can actually find in stock items.

reviews.title: Hard to get connected with customer service
reviews.text: So I ordered clothes before Thanksgiving and it got delivered earlier this week. It says it was delivered around 5pm but I got home around 10pm already, first thing I did was look for the package and I couldn’t find it at all. Their customer service is only in the app and you can message them but they will take two days to get back at you and when I told them that I couldn’t find my package and that it was either missing or stolen, they will send you this post where it says you need to “ACCEPT THE DECLARATION LETTER” stating that you already looked around, talk to your neighbors and ask family members with your package. And they will do their investigation on their own and will also include the police because of the missing or stolen package. I told them that I live in a neighborhood where people doesn’t talk to one another. People go on their own day and mind their own business but it’s not a close off neighborhood that it does have a gate or private entrance. I expressed my situation with them but they still keep telling me I need to say that I accept the declaration letter that all that was stated in there was done before they start the investigation. And I keep telling them if I accept it, it’s like me lying that I did talked to my neighbors regarding my missing package even though I did not because like I said I dont talk to my neighbors. But gymshark still won’t do anything with it unless you say you accept the declaration letter. So basically I just lost $100.
